mapper.select: SELECT P.ID AS id , P.TITLE AS title , P.CONTENT AS content , P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt , P.MEM_EMAIL AS memEmail , M.MEM_NICKNAME AS memNickname , M.MEM_PROFILE_IMG AS memProfileImg FROM POSTS P LEFT JOIN MEM_INFO M ON P.MEM_EMAIL = M.MEM_EMAIL WHERE P.ID = #{id}

SELECT P.ID AS id , P.TITLE AS title , P.CONTENT AS content , P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt , P.MEM_EMAIL AS memEmail , M.MEM_NICKNAME AS memNickname , M.MEM_PROFILE_IMG AS memProfileImg FROM POSTS P LEFT JOIN MEM_INFO M ON P.MEM_EMAIL = M.MEM_EMAIL ORDER BY P.UPDATED_AT DESC
